projects.title: ULTRA — Bletchley Park Intelligence Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Modular Java & PostgreSQL Cryptanalysis, Gemini Classification & Observer Routing Engine
highlights: Decoupled interception, strategy-based cryptanalysis, AI triage, and need-to-know branch dispatch
Automated blind Vigenère cryptanalysis via Kasiski examination and frequency analysis
Resilient AI classification with retry/backoff and safe ALL | ROUTINE fallback on timeout or failure
Transactional state transitions in PostgreSQL (PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE / FAILED)

components.name: Ultra.Main & Ultra
components.role: Entry point and pipeline orchestrator coordinating queue polling, decryption, classification, and observer dispatch

components.name: RadioStationSimulator & Repository
components.role: Simulates intercepted radio transmissions, validates cipher types, and manages message states in the PostgreSQL INPUT table

components.name: CipherFactory & CipherType
components.role: Fail-fast enum validation and Factory resolution for concrete DecryptionStrategy implementations

components.name: CaesarDecrypt & VigenereCracker
components.role: Statistical cryptanalysis strategies (26-shift chi-squared scoring for Caesar; Kasiski key-length estimation + coset frequency analysis for Vigenère)

components.name: MessageClassifier & LlmMessageClassifier
components.role: Semantic triage via Gemini REST API returning Branch and Urgency, with HTTP/1.1 timeouts, 429 retry backoff, and safe fallback

components.name: Observer & AbstractBranchObserver
components.role: Pub/Sub need-to-know routing across Navy, RAF, Army, PM_OFFICE, and SHAEF headquarters
